intended_application: edible coating for postharvest preservation of cherry tomatoes

process_steps.description: Orange peel pieces frozen in liquid nitrogen and freeze-dried

source.quote: The prepared peel pieces were rapidly frozen using food-grade liquid nitrogen and subsequently freeze-dried for 48 h

process_steps.description: Freeze-dried peel ground and sieved through 150 mesh

source.quote: A portion of this material (85 g) was ground and passed through a 150-mesh sieve

process_steps.description: Peel powder heated in citric acid solution to extract pectin and bioactives

source.quote: Orange peel powder (40 g) was mixed with 400 mL of 4% (w/v) citric acid solution (pH 2.0) and heated at 80 °C for 90 min
The extract was centrifuged and filtered through Whatman No. 1 filter paper

process_steps.description: Pectin precipitated from the remaining filtrate with ethanol

source.quote: The remaining filtrate was precipitated with 400 mL of 95% ethanol
freeze-dried for 24 h at a shelf temperature of −4 °C

process_steps.description: Sodium alginate dissolved in distilled water

source.quote: 0.30 g sodium alginate was dissolved in 66.7 mL distilled water at 60 °C

process_steps.description: Orange peel extract, glycerol and pectin solution added

source.quote: followed by addition of 5.3 mL orange peel extract, 1.4 mL glycerol, and 33.3 mL pectin solution (1.5 g pectin in 100 mL distilled water)

process_steps.description: Chitosan solution added and homogenised at 10,000 rpm

source.quote: Formulation 2 (F2) incorporated 5.0 mL chitosan solution (1 g chitosan and 1 g citric acid in 100 mL distilled water), homogenised at 10,000 rpm for 3 min

process_steps.description: Clove essential oil pre-homogenised with Tween 80 at 8000 rpm

source.quote: 0.3 mL clove essential oil pre-homogenised with 0.2 mL Tween 80 at 8000 rpm for 2 min

process_steps.description: Degassed in an open glass vessel

source.quote: The solution (15 mL) was degassed for 10 min in an open glass vessel

process_steps.description: 20 mL cast into a 90 mm glass Petri dish

source.quote: 20 mL of each coating solution was poured into sterile 90 mm glass Petri dishes
dried in a hot-air oven at 37 °C for 16 h
